ruleset: Ken Oki Microgame V0 — verified timing + empirical spacing

reference.frame_data: SF6 Lab official-reference table, referenced 2026-08-27; cross-checked with Ultimate Frame Data

frame_semantics.startup_rule: startup N means frames 1..N-1 are startup-only and frame N is the first active frame
frame_semantics.stun_definition: hitstun/blockstun counts the contact frame itself as stun frame 1
frame_semantics.late_contact_rule: stun is fixed; each later active-frame contact increases raw advantage by 1F
frame_semantics.cancel_rule: cancel discards all remaining active/recovery of the current move
frame_semantics.cancel_transition: for a contact cancel, child action frame 1 starts on the next global frame
frame_semantics.branch_transition: for an explicitly available follow-up branch, child action frame 1 starts on the branch-input global frame unless an empirical override exists
frame_semantics.true_blockstring_rule: true blockstring requires at least 1F overlap with defender blockstun; a next hit on the defender's first actionable frame is 0F gap but NOT a true blockstring

advantage_formula.cancel_combo: after cancel at contact with delay d, gap = child_startup + d - defender_stun; gap<0 means stun overlap and a true combo/blockstring, while gap=0 has no free frame but no overlap

system_rules.throw_resolution: failed first active capture attempt resolves the throw as whiff
system_rules.simplified_multi_hit_rule: After first contact in a valid full-hit range, use the aggregate move damage, count all listed hits against DI armor, and apply the final hit's knockdown/end state. Per-hit spatial trajectories are not simulated.

hit_level_semantics.non_attack: movement/state/system action with no direct strike hit level

throw_invulnerability.frame_counting: begins on the first actionable frame after the corresponding state ends

5LP.hurtbox_note: Ken crouching hurtbox is horizontally longer; user measured 5LP crouch-contact range 146.51 vs standing 141.76.

spacing_on_block.source: user empirical measurements; corrected repeated-distance series confirmed as 5LK

stun.note: blockstun fixed; hitstun left unset because V0 does not need an airborne/juggle model

throw_forward.capture_resolution: if first throw-active collision attempt occurs while target is throw-invulnerable/unthrowable, resolve as whiff; do not reacquire on later listed active frames

throw_back.capture_resolution: if first throw-active collision attempt occurs while target is throw-invulnerable/unthrowable, resolve as whiff; do not reacquire on later listed active frames

quick_dash_thunder_kick.source_note: SF6 Lab gives 18-20 active / +3 / -3; UFD currently disagrees (-4 and 4 active), so this V0 follows SF6 Lab plus the user's 3rd-active +5 calibration.

stun.derivation: fixed from first-active-frame published advantage when numeric

validation_cases.name: late_active_rule
validation_cases.computed: raw_advantage +1F per later active; cancel timing unchanged

validation_requirements: Every move entry must contain hit_level in {overhead, mid, low, throw, non_attack}.
The first actionable frame after wakeup has 1F throw invulnerability.
The first two actionable frames after hitstun or blockstun have throw invulnerability.

distance_model.contact_rule: contact if current distance <= effective_range[defender_posture] for a supported move
distance_model.block_spacing_transition: d_after = max(D_min, d_contact + delta) when parameters are identified
distance_model.cancel_rule: if recovery animation is cancelled, do not apply displacement belonging to the cancelled recovery; use a cancel-specific D_min when empirically available

5HP_then_5LP_whiff.note: 5HP full recovery leaves 157.52 > standing 5LP range 141.76, so the following 5LP is a whiff; the end distance is not a block-pushback measurement.

623HK_or_notation_263HK.note: notation preserved from user table; move identity should be confirmed before using.

data_quality_notes: The repeated-distance series previously labelled '5LP' (70->149.17, 101.99->156.16, 156.16->210.32, 133.95->188.11, 86.8->149.17, 91.57->149.17) is confirmed by the user to be 5LK. It supports the 5LK spacing model d_after=max(149.17, d_contact+54.16/54.17).
Thunder Kick public databases disagree: SF6 Lab gives active 18-20 and -3 on block; UFD displays 4 active and -4. This V0 follows SF6 Lab because it matches the user's 3-active +43 calibration.
Unmeasured crouching ranges default to standing range only as an explicit V0 assumption.

verification_summary.public_frame_data_checked_against: SF6 Lab Ken frame table; UFD used as secondary cross-check
major_corrections_from_v0_3: All derived hitstun/blockstun values now include the contact frame, removing the previous +1F error.
2MP blockstun is 17F under this counting; fastest cancel M Jinrai overlaps by 1F, delay-1 is 0F gap and not a true blockstring.
5HP last-active raw advantage is +7; cancel to H Jinrai is 0F gap and not a combo.
Dragonlash practical contact indices and crouch-dependent +1F late contact are explicitly calibrated.
Distance system now uses actual game-coordinate units and stance-dependent ranges.
major_corrections_from_v0_4: Corrected the mislabeled repeated spacing series from 5LP to 5LK; 5LP remains 70->103.33, while 5LK uses the 149.17 floor and ~54.16 pushback.
